meta.title: H3 Tech | Semiconductor Automation Equipment · AI Control Systems
meta.description: H3 Tech provides automation equipment, AI control systems, and factory automation solutions for the semiconductor and display industries.

hero.headlineMain: Chemical process equipment, from design to
hero.body: We supply chemical-process parts and automation equipment for semiconductor, display, and surface-treatment, one-stop.

solutionReveal.body: For sites where products, chemicals, temperature, and installation conditions all differ, H3-Tech carries the work from design and fabrication to assembly, control, and delivery.

s1.title: Consultation
s1.desc: We capture your requirements and site conditions.

s2.title: Survey & design
s2.desc: We measure on site and design the layout and drawings.

s3.title: CNC machining
s3.desc: We machine precisely to the approved drawings.

s4.title: Fabrication & welding
s4.desc: We weld PVC/PP into the finished structures.

s5.title: Installation
s5.desc: We install on site and connect the exhaust ducting.

s6.title: Maintenance
s6.desc: We provide regular inspection and fast service.

q1.q: How do I get a quote?
q1.a: Send your requirements via the contact form or by phone; we review your site conditions and provide a tailored quote.

q2.a: It depends on scale and spec, but usually 2–6 weeks after the design is finalized.

q3.a: Mainly PVC and PP for their chemical resistance and durability, chosen to fit the application.

q4.a: Yes — from fabrication to on-site install and exhaust ducting, all in one.

q5.a: We provide regular inspections and fast after-sales support after installation.

q6.a: Fill out the form on the Contact page or call our main line.

globe.headline: Proven at Korea's core industrial sites — now reaching for the world

domains.title: Parts and equipment for chemical-process-critical industries
domains.body: We deliver chemical-resistant parts and custom automation equipment for semiconductor, display, and surface-treatment processes — from design through installation.

parts.title: Chemical-resistant parts
parts.body: We design and machine parts with materials and geometry optimized for chemical-exposure environments, for repeat supply.

equipment.title: Custom automation equipment
equipment.body: We build and install chemical-process equipment optimized for each site — design through assembly and control, one stop.

ax.title: Process-optimization AX system
ax.body: We analyze equipment process data and operating conditions with AI to recommend optimal settings and manage quality, output, and equipment health.

strengths.title: All-round capability across field, design, and research
strengths.body: With interdisciplinary engineering spanning three fields and our own one-stop production system, we deliver parts and equipment optimized for each site, fast.

tech.title: Interdisciplinary engineering
tech.body: Our all-round, one-stop production system delivers engineering services roughly 20% faster than the industry standard.

model.title: Business model
model.body: We supply chemical-resistant parts and custom equipment fitted to each client's environment, building steady revenue through equipment builds and repeat parts supply.

network.title: Network
network.body: We've signed MOUs with 4 automation-equipment makers and secured 15 existing accounts — a sales base built for collaborative production and repeat orders.

future.title: Future service
future.body: We're developing an AX system that analyzes equipment process data and operating conditions with AI to recommend optimal process conditions.

vision.title: Growing into an AX technology company on a foundation of manufacturing revenue
vision.body: We secure cash flow from custom equipment and parts revenue, and continuously reinvest it in developing AI technology for chemical-process optimization.

p1.label: PHASE 1
p1.title: Building the company foundation
p1.body: Establishing an R&D division, venture-company and ISO 9001 certification, and securing manufacturing revenue and references

p2.label: PHASE 2
p2.title: Developing and validating AX technology
p2.body: Developing process data collection/control systems and AI vision, validated through government R&D and PoCs

p3.label: PHASE 3
p3.title: Scaling AX and evaluating commercialization
p3.body: Advancing process-condition optimization and expanding the business model into new channels such as open innovation and the public sector

history.title: History
history.subtitle: History
history.lead: H3-Tech was founded on engineering experience accumulated in chemical process and automation equipment sites. We are building a manufacturing base that can handle design, machining, fabrication, assembly, and control as a one-stop workflow while expanding around chemical-process parts and equipment.
